Marco (AE): Heads up — FortuneCo wants a 2-week Dedicated POC, asking for 25% off list for first month and a custom availability SLA. Do we have a template route?
Ellen (Deal Desk): short answer: yes. Need CPQ flags + usage estimate. >20% or custom SLA triggers manager approval. Fill these CPQ fields: Discount_pct, Commitment_Type, POC_flag, SLA_Profile, Estimated_GPU_hours, Approval_Route.
Rory (SE): technical callback: POC will use dedicated capacity with 4 GPUs, expected 10k tokens/day. If they want KV cache persisted to Private, that changes infra.
Marco (AE): customer prefers hosted but will accept dedicated. I'll mark Private=false for now.
Ellen (Deal Desk): good. Sample CPQ snippet to paste into SFDC:```json
{
  "Discount_pct": "25",
  "Commitment_Type": "monthly_reserved",
  "POC_flag": "true",
  "SLA_Profile": "poc-custom-availability",
  "Estimated_GPU_hours": "480",
  "Approval_Route": "dealdesk_manager"
}
```
Marco (AE): who signs off when Approval_Route=dealdesk_manager?
approve-bot: Approval ticket created DD-8012. Routing: Ellen -> Priya (Finance) if discount >=22% -> Priya approves budgets -> Ellen signs final. Manager SLAs: 48 business hours.
Priya (Finance): FYI finance pre-approval: up to 25% for POC if committed spend >= $5k. If below $5k, need CRO eyes. Send projected invoice.
Marco (AE): projected invoice is $6.2k for month 1 at requested discount. attaching calc in SFDC.
Ellen (Deal Desk): legal-bot will flag custom SLA for review. Also attach the standard POC SOW template.
legal-bot: Auto-note: custom SLA includes uptime clause and reduced liability for POC. Manual review required. Tagging @Legal.
Rory (SE): quick ops note: if we ship dedicated nodes, ops needs 72h lead time; if customer wants KMS, add 48h. Update the POC runbook.
Priya (Finance): approving budget path now since $6.2k >= $5k. Priya -> Ellen: approve.
Ellen (Deal Desk): approved. Routing complete. Marco, you'll get signed pricing and SOW via SFDC. Please confirm once customer signs. :thumbsup:
Marco (AE): confirmed, will update thread when signed. thanks all.
